reason: I already treat settlement emails as spam, and a free site promising to show me class-action money is the same pitch. You don't even file for me or verify the listings, so I am not giving you an account or my time.
objection: How do you even know I qualify, and why would I trust an unverified site with anything when it still sends me off to fill out the form myself?
would_change_my_mind: If my bank or a company I actually use sent me a real official notice I could check on their site, and this just linked me there with no account, I might click through once.
